snippet.title: Los Angeles Crimes - v1.8
snippet.description:
Download Los Angeles Crimes v1.8 on Play Store:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MA.LAC&hl=en&gl=US

What's New:
 New Helicopter: HummingBird
 All vehicles can now be exploded
 New editor objects: Reflective cube, Mirror cube, Maxwell, Vehicle statistics
 New commands: /explode, /report [id]
 Garage now shows vehicle statistics
 120FPS option
 Slow-Mo death option
 In-game Triggerbox doc
 New triggerbox commands
